annotations.title: Get the UFCalendar Power Index board

description: The UFCalendar Power Index board for one promotion — our own rating engine, refreshed hourly, with peak rating and fights rated. Pass view=movers for the biggest risers over a window, view=peaks for all-time peak ratings, division= to narrow.

days.description: Window for view=movers, in days. Default 365. days is snapped to 30/90/180/365/730/1825/3650.

division.description: Division slug to narrow the board, e.g. "lightweight", "light-heavyweight", "womens-strawweight".

view.description: current (default) = active fighters by rating; movers = biggest risers over `days`; peaks = all-time peak ratings reached in this promotion.

name: get_power_index
